summary: Iteration 2 - validated the ForestEvent refactor end-to-end. 28/28 pytest backend tests passed covering the NEW /api/events surface (CRUD, filters by severity/event_type/country/status, /event-types catalogue of 7 types, /stats with by_severity + by_event_type, 422 on invalid event_type, 404 on missing id), NEW /api/notifications (list + 404 on mark-read unknown), LEGACY /api/alerts compatibility shape (id/title/region/country/severity/area_ha/location.{lat,lng}/source/confidence/detected_at/status with NO new keys leaking), /api/alerts/stats legacy shape, auth (register/login/me/refresh/logout) and modules. Frontend smoke test confirmed dashboard renders 20 seeded alerts, severity bar (Low 5 / Medium 5 / High 6 / Critical 4), recent-activity table, and /map renders 20/20 Leaflet markers — verifying the legacy adapter still drives the unchanged UI.

minor.issue: Endpoint is unauthenticated (no get_current_user dep) while every other /api/events route requires auth. Likely intentional as a public catalogue, but worth confirming.
Returns HTTP 200 with not_found payload instead of 404 (pre-existing from iter1, unrelated to refactor).

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether /api/events/event-types should require auth for consistency with the rest of /api/events.
(Optional, carry-over) Return HTTP 404 from GET /api/modules/{name} when module not found.
critical_code_review_comments: AlertService is a clean adapter over ForestEventService that maps affected_area_ha->area_ha and latitude/longitude->location.{lat,lng}; old /api/alerts shape is fully preserved.
ForestEventRepository.stats() exposes both total_events and total_alerts back-compat key so legacy /api/alerts/stats works without divergence.
Pydantic Literal enums (EventType, Severity, EventStatus) correctly yield 422 on invalid values — verified test_create_invalid_event_type.
Mongo _id is properly excluded across all responses (Pydantic Public models do not include _id).
Notification.mark_read raises NotFoundError -> mapped to HTTP 404 via app_error_handler — verified.
Files are well-modularised (models / repositories / services / api layers separated; no >700-line files detected).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 20 ForestEvent records on startup spanning 7 event_types (logging=5, wildfire=4, agriculture=6, mining=1, road_construction=2, urban_expansion=1, unknown=1) and 4 severities. Test class TestEvents.test_create_get_update_delete_event creates and cleans up its own TEST_create_event record.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL+/api. Auth uses httpOnly cookies; use requests.Session(). 28 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py organised into TestHealth/TestAuth/TestEvents/TestNotifications/TestLegacyAlerts/TestModules. Run via: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Note: server seeds 20 ForestEvents only when forest_events collection is empty (idempotent). Frontend testids confirmed: login-{email,password,submit}, dashboard-page, nav-{dashboard,map,modules}. Legacy /api/alerts shape MUST keep field names area_ha + location.{lat,lng} + source (NOT affected_area_ha/latitude/longitude/source_id) — UI depends on it.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found. Refactor is correctly implemented; canonical ForestEvent domain works and the legacy /api/alerts adapter preserves the old shape so the existing frontend continues to render unchanged.
